notes.title: A new achievement, and my new game CHAOS FRONT Announced!
notes.notes:
It's a long time, my friends!

Chaos Galaxy 2 has added an achievement called Four Admirals. The first player to achieve it was 风飞翔. Let's challenge it! 
Tip: Use Southeaven or Northsky and have the Princess establish the Galactic Empire on the other side.

In addition, I wanted to share some exciting news with you. The latest addition to the Chaos Galaxy series, CHAOS FRONT, has been announced! It's a new story set in the world of Chaos Galaxy, taking us back to a thousand years ago during the dark age of the galactic war. Players will take on the role of a mercenary corps that operates in the middle of this chaos.

You can find it at the following link: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2770330/Chaos_Front/

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 released
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, my friends!

Let me explain the reason for this update first. One year ago, a player on Discord proposed adding an achievement: to use the Blackdragon Spawns to win without summoning the Black Dragon. And this seems impossible, you can only use the initial five alien fleets without any losses, because without the Black Dragon, you cannot resurrect any fleet, and each fleet will be lost forever after defeat. I told him that as long as someone can complete this challenge, I am willing to add this achievement.
A year has passed and I have forgotten about it.
But today, this player PCSgtL appeared on Discord again, showing a screenshot and savedata of him using only 5 initial alien fleets to win the game! And he remind me not to forget what I said a year ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/d499925df2300606d31389a3d5bc89303cbd9ca4.png[/img]
I won't break my promise. So I immediately worked overtime at night to make the new achievement!
Let's try this super difficult challenge that requires one year of proficient skills to complete! Of course, I give up first...
I modified a bug by the way. AI will no longer say something that are quickly obscured by black screens at the beginning of some battles.

This year has been a difficult year for me. My father first fell ill and later passed away. I have returned to my hometown multiple times to accompany him in the hospital. My planning new game also encountered many difficulties in the art concept step(the game I once mentioned that only one planet as the gamestage). Finally, the plan had to be restarted after wasting several months. Now this game will take place in the space, but the player is not playing a faction, but choosing one mercenary group to play. The era background of the game is a thousand years before the Chaos Galaxy, during the chaotic period after the fall of the Solar Union.
I hope next year will be more lucky and I can complete this new game before the end of next year.
I also hope that all friends will have good luck in 2024! Let's look forward to it!

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 1.0 released
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, my friends!

In the half a year of EA period, Chaos Galaxy 2 has updated many big contents such as Alien Faction, Mozi Ark, Custom Commander, and Custom Faction, made hundreds of adjustments, and fixed hundreds of bugs. The English text has also been polished and improved by the players. Thanks to your support and suggestions that Chaos Galaxy 2 can successfully complete the EA.

In this update, I added cards, badges, emos and backgrounds for Steam community to the game, and the following adjustments have been made.

Gameplay improvement:

1. Added some hover prompts in the UI.
2. When the player fleet starts the pre-engagement dialogue, the total power of the enemy and ours will be displayed.
3. The unit data UI at the lower left corner of the battlefield will display the faction emblem which the unit belongs. The commander's name of the unit's fleet will be showed by hovering the cursor on the emblem.
4. The damage of EMP gun is increased to 140.
5. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed the problem that the color of the unit in the unit data UI at the lower left corner of the battlefield is sometimes displayed incorrectly.
2. Fixed the problem that the character-setting arrows in the Custom Commander UI sometimes doesnot work correctly.
3. Fixed the problem that the UI might get stuck when a custom faction is selecting a leader.4. Fixed the incorrect number of enemy losses on the BattleEnd panel.
4. Fixed the problem that an Imperial custom faction cannot trigger the event of Jing abdication.
5. Fixed the problem that the place commander UI stuck after deleting a custom faction.
6. Fixed a problem with the hire UI getting stuck when hiring a custom commander without any skills.

After the 1.0 version of Chaos Galaxy 2 is released, there will be no new content updates, but I will collect feedback bugs and repair them when they accumulate to a certain amount. Most of my time and energy will be devoted to the preparation of my next game.

Although there is no information to share, I would like to briefly describe my thoughts on the next game.
This new game still belongs to the Chaos Galaxy universe. but it will choose another time point. The game stage is only one planet (including its orbital space). Mecha and other arms will fight in cities, snowfields, deserts and oceans. Terrible satellite lances often fall from the sky and cut the earth.

Since CG2 has nearly 300 units, I didn't make "cut in scene" battle animations like CG1 and Chaos Sector. As a result, CG2 has received bad comments from many players. In my new game, I intend to reduce the number of unit kinds to less than 100, so that I can bear the time cost of making these battle animations. In addition, I may allow players to customize the weapons, armor and auxiliary parts of the units to keep the richness of the battle experience.

Just as CG2's content is richer than CG1 and CG1 is more mature than Chaos Sector, when I am making the new game, my skills also exceeds that when I was making CG2. You can expect the new game will be a more interesting game than my past works.

I expect to release more detailed information about the new game in the second half of 2023. I will let you know by the announcement at that time. Thank you again, and let's meet again in my next game!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.9.4 Update

Bug Fixed:

2. Fixed the problem that the policy Notoriety Tyrant does not take effect on the battlefield when a custom faction uses the Southern Principality Policy Tree.

Bug Fixed:

2. Fixed the problem that when Lord Guangwu's tactical skill reduces the enemy's morale, the power bar is showed instead of the morale bar .

3. Fixed the problem that mercenary and assassin's available task list was cleared after any faction was destroyed.

notes.title: Version 0.9.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends! Let's see the content of this update.

Gameplay improvement:

1. The weapon with fan range (Dragon Breath) has a correct damage range now.
2. When the enemy units use map weapons in the battlefield, the damage range will be showed.
3. When a unit hit by a torpedo, it is no longer a fixed damage. The effect of the Carapace and the buffs of Hardened Carapace, Imperial Shield, Sacrifice, the Aegis Shield, and Hold Fast will affect the damage.
4. When an adjacent unit is hit by ram weapons and cause collision damage to a unit, the effect of the Carapace and the buffs of Hardened Carapace, Imperial Shield, Sacrifice, the Aegis Shield, and Hold Fast will affect the damage.
5. When the AI has a small number of planets, its economic bonus will be lesser.
6. The effect of Khusro's talent Dune Chieftain has been changed to: Fleet cannon hit rate +10.
7. The Instakill will now be judged only when the target is hit and causing damage. It will not be checked when the attack misses.
8. In the Alienate action, the vassals of other factions can no longer be selected as the target except the vassals of diplomatic target.
9. The Blood Sucking bio-chip is changed to Pugnacity, and the effect is: Fleet combat weapons damage +10%.
10. The effect of Efficiency EMP in the Free Stars‘ policy tree has been modified to EMP Gun damage +40.
11. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed the bug that AI can attack or recruit after Forced March.
2. Fixed the bug that sometimes the Black Dragon will hatch the same Apostle that already exists.
3. Fixed the bug that the power bar of units sometimes exceed the UI range when two fleets are transfering units.
4. Fixed the bug that custom commanders sometimes display other commanders' portrait when using tactical skills.
5. Fixed the bug that we cannot attack mercenary and assassin fleets that have missions against us.
6. Fixed the bug that the attacking animation effects of Jueying and Sword Fighter were not positioned correctly.

See you next update.


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 Update & Custom Commander available
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

First of all, I must apologize. I originally planned to finish this version in three weeks, but because the art work exceeded my expectations, it took me a whole month to finally complete them. In this version, we can customize commanders to join the game. After clicking the Custom button on the start menu and creating new commanders, we can let these commanders join our games. We can place them to some factions or set them as wandering roles. We cannot create new factions yet in this version, but it will be my work target in the next stage.

By the way, there is another important function worth telling. In this version, I adjusted some formats of the savedata, and now the time to open the Save Menu is significantly shorter than before. However, we need to manually overwrite the old savedatas in the new version. If it is an important old savedata to be collected, we can load it and overwritten it in the original slot. If it is not important, it is recommended to directly overwrite it with a new savedata. Only by overwriting the savedatas in the old format can we speed up the opening of the Save Menu. Please experience it.

Because the Custom Commander takes up too much development time, 0.9.0 does not add other optimizations and bug fixing. I expect to release two updates about game optimization and bug fixing in the next two weeks. Then I will start to develop the last major content in EA: Custom Faction.

There is about a month before the 1.0 version, because the discount requires an at least 28 days cooling period after a price change, next week I plan to raise the price of Chaos Galaxy 2 to the official price for 1.0 version.

See you next update.

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.8.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

A major update this time is the setting of the fleet base. Both the returned and newly recruited fleets will appear on the fleet base planet. We can spend a certain amount of gold to set up a new base according to the changes in the front. It should be noted that once the fleet base is captured, we will lose some prestige.

Gameplay improvement:

1. The effect of the Agile in the Evolution of the Blackdragon Spawns has been modified to increase the agility of all alien units by 10.
2. In the Collection UI, the name of the commander who owns the command unit will be showed in the desc of the command  unit that has not been collected.
3. If the Royalist Alliance or the Regent Forces are vassals, the event will not be triggered when them destroyed the other.
4. The limit of Space Hacker has been changed to 3, and their power has been increased.
5. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed the wrong desc of the Strategy Skill Forced March.
2. Fixed a bug that AI did not prioritize the use of Lock on the battlefield.
3. Fixed a bug that when a team unit makes a double attack, even if it loses the number of soldiers in enemy's counter attack, it will also cause damage by the initial number of soldiers .
4. Fixed a bug that when a bio-unit makes a double attack, it will launch a second attack even if it gets a Crippled debuff in enemy's counterattack.
5. Fixed a bug that the resources of Grand Armada in the selection UI does not match the actual number.
6. Fixed a bug that when Lord Wenchang became the Prime Minister and triggered the event New Prime Minister, there would be wrong dialogue.
7. Fixed a bug that 10000 resources are asked for truce but 20000 resources  are actually paid.
8. Fixed a bug that our fighter unit could not be selected because it flew into the fog after being controlled by AI.
9. Fixed a bug that Su Yan's tactical skill Psionic Trap's effect and description do not match.

Version 0.8 has come to an end. I am going to start the work for Custom-Commander of version 0.9. Because this content requires a lot of new art resources and many new codes. Therefore, it is estimated that it will take more than 3 weeks to complete.

Autumn is coming, please keep warm. See you next month!

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

The main body of version 0.8 is finally completed. In this version, we can finally using aliens to sweep the galaxy. Aliens use different resources from humans, and their game goal is completely different. Along with this version, a number of new collections and a new achievement are available.

In the campaign settings, we can set the alien invasion direction now. Click the four directional arrows to set that aliens will arrive at the galaxy from one of the four directions of East, South, West and North in this game.

Gameplay improvement:

1. Now when mercenaries (or assassins) accept a mission against a faction, mercenaries (or assassins) and the mission target can attack each other.
2. With a series of systematic checks, mercenaries (or assassins) could not be allies with the mission target or establish a relationship of suzerain and vassal. If they become an ally due to passive reasons, the mission will automatically fail.
3. The proportion of AI economic bonus is reduced.
4. The battlefield AI is corrected to avoid the problem that AI units do not take any action after being surrounded by units with Devour ability. 
5. The effect of Jochi's tactical skill Lightning Strike has been modified to: All of our fighters will dodge enemy's ranged attack this turn.
6. The effect of Hector's talent Invincible has been modified to: Fleet unit damage + 20%.
7. Commanders can now gain credit by capturing planet and training fleet. The credit gained by commanders staying on the planet is increased. (the number of credit is related to the commander's admin)
8. When we issue missions to mercenary, the target can no longer be a wasteland planet.
9. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed a bug that the Premise policy description of alien technology is incorrect.
2. Fixed a bug that Wufeng's tactical skill Ferocious Threat doesnot take effect.
3. Fixed a bug that the submarine don't appear after being attacked by artillery.
4. Fixed a bug that the two biochips: Strength and Vision did not work.
5. Fixed a bug that vassals of Imperial Foe can attack Imperial factions, but Imperial factions can't attack them.

Another thing, after repeated thinking, I feel that the planed event Iron Wings is not fun enough, so I will delete that content from the development plan. At the same time, two Iron Wing commanders that have been completed are added to the list of hireable commanders, and human factions can recruit them in the game.

From tomorrow I will start work for the version 0.8.0. It is expected that we can play the Blackdragon Spawns after two weeks' development.
There are two more updates related to game experience optimization in version 0.8. The plan includes quick saving and loading, setting the faction fleet base(the assembly point after the revival and withdrawal of the fleets), etc.

See you next update.

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Wandering Ark & English text Improving
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

The Wandering Ark, the first milestone of EA, has finally been completed. In this version, human factions will encounter visiting Mozi ark, and trade learning points, blueprints and skill chips with the ark. The relationship of each other will be improved during the transaction. With the increase of relationship, more advanced blueprints and chips and more learning points can be purchased. When the relationship is max, a mysterious event will also be triggered. And if the Omnic Apocalypse can successfully pursue and destroy Mozi ark, it will also open another road for them. Along with this version, a number of new collections and achievements are available.

Another important thing is that RustyRed, a player on discord, proofread the English text of the whole game and carefully polished it. Let's thank him for his dedication!

Gameplay improvement:

1. Now when we start the game, we can choose the economic bonus settings of players and AI.
2. Improved the governance effect of fleet commanders staying on the planet.
3. AI won't start attack until the third month.
4. Reduced the number of months and cost spent for the policy of Luna Battlecruiser.
5. Removed one Cog Tradeship from the initial fleet of Duke Liefeng.
6. The exiled  Princess Jing will not visit the Imperial factions that have become vassals.
7. In auto-battle, the pirates can no longer capture the units that have Indomitable and the Omnic units mastered the Policy Omnic Liberate.
8. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed a bug that might cause crush in auto-battle.
2. Fixed a bug that the fleet buttons on the right side would be invalid after clicking the Next Month button and cancel.
3. Fixed a bug that the Omnic units mastered the Policy Omnic Liberate are still affected by the tactical skills that reduce morale.
4. Fixed a bug that the battlefield has a 21st turn.

From tomorrow I will start work for the version 0.8.0. It is expected that we can play the Blackdragon Spawns after two weeks' development.
Please look forward to the coming of the black dragon!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.7.9 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

In this update, the AI action speed on galaxy map has been accelerated, and the battle animation speed on the battlefield has also been accelerated.

Gameplay improvement:

1. The labor points produced by the Immigration Office has been increased.
2. AI on the battlefield will give priority to move to space buildings only when their power or energy are not full.
3. We will no longer get bio-units' blueprints when destroying other factions.
4. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed a bug that Strategic skills could be used on the wasteland planet.
2. Fixed a bug that the units with carapace may not lose durability when being bombarded by the artillery.
3. Fixed a bug that the direction in game is not completely accurate.
4. Fixed several issues related to the weapon selection interface.
5. Fixed a bug that the value of reducing defense by bombing is wrong in report.
6. Fixed a bug that some weapons consume incorrect energy in auto-battle.
7. Fixed a bug that the damage calculation may be incorrect if the carapace is broken in the battle.
8. Fixed a bug that the melee weapons can still attack the opponent if it is pushed away by the ram weapons during the second attack.

At present, the version 0.7 is basically stable. Next, I will start to work for the first milestone of the EA: The Wandering Ark. This content is expected to take about a whole week to finish.
Please wait for the new events!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.7.8 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

Many players complained that the operations on the planetary UI is too cumbersome. Player gigamelon1981 posted a design for the planetary UI on the Steam community, which was supported by many people. Therefore, I made some adjustments on the basis of the design drawing of gigamelon1981  and completed the current planetary UI. Although there is some crowded, but we donot need to switch between the orbit and the surface now. In addition, the boxes of production buildings and defense buildings are no longer represented by the words "B" and "D", but are showed by the silver frame and the brass frame respectively.

Gameplay improvement:

1. When the selected player's fleet can move, we can click the commander's portrait of on the fleet list on the right again to let fleet stay for command.
2. Except that the currently selected player's fleet has moved and is waiting for command, we can click other commander's portraits on the fleet list on the right to switch the selected fleet.
3. The damage radius of Hammerfall is reduced by 1.
4. After being bombed by map weapons, the reduced morale value was adjusted from 20 to 15.
5. The probability of AI declaring war on neighboring neutral factions is Increased .
6. If an imperial faction is a vassal, and the suzerain is not an imperial faction, it will not automatically fight with the Imperial Foe.
7. AI will no longer use Pulse Cannon if the opponent has no energy during counterattack.
8. Some text descriptions are adjusted.

Bug Fixed:

1. Fixed a bug that map weapons kill enemies in the fog may cause the game to crush.
2. Fixed a bug that the Policy Queen's Charm of the Eastocean Fleet causing the faction could not hire commanders.
3. Fixed a bug that some units donot consume energy in auto-battle.
4. Fixed some bugs about the Rank UI.
5. Fixed some incorrect dialogue in events.
6. Fixed a bug that the garage UI could not scroll below the fourth row.
7. Fixed a bug that AI might accept the Mission of a perished faction.

See you next update!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.7.7 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

The AI behavior of mercenary faction and assassin faction has recently caused many people puzzled. So I made some adjustments.

1. When mercenaries and assassins accept a mission against the player, there will be a message to the player.
2. When mercenary and assassins have a mission against a certain faction, they will not be able to become allies, suzerain or vassal with the faction.

2. AI units will give priority to the locked enemies when selecting shooting targets.
3. Reduced the using weight of lock ability, especially when the unit has weapons.
4. Reduced the strength of the spaceworms in auto-battle.

6. The Imperial Supportship in the initial team of Brasidas were changed to Mercenary Barge.

9. Healing Balls can now heal themselves.
10. The unit type of the spaceworm has been changed to Support, and reduced movement by 1 point. All units with Devour ability will get Nimble ability and adjusted other stats.

Bug Fixed:

2. Fixed a bug that reborn Immortal Soul will overlap with enemy units after being devoured.
3. Fixed a bug that the Knowledge of a decoding unit will become 0 when the Knowledge is increased to 100 in the battle.
4. Fixed a bug that click the icon of Doom Starfort could not open its panel.
5. Fixed a bug that the Imperial Foe added the rebels and local forces of the imperial type to the enemy list.
6. Fixed a bug that Training Ground did not reduce recruitment costs.

8. Fixed a bug that pirate will get all units' disband supply after dealing with captured enemy units.
9. Fixed a bug that sometimes the enemy fleets' power are displayed incorrect.
10. Fixed a bug that map gun weapons could not trigger the Loot ability.
11. Fixed a bug that AI's Jing can control biological units by using the tactical skill  Order of Princess.
12. Fixed a bug that a planet's ownership is not displayed correctly on map when selecting factions.
13. Fixed a bug that the Suicide Nuke did not set the enemy on fire.
14. Fixed a bug that the Aerie Assassins was still in the enemy list of the Omnic Apocalypse after independence.
15. Fixed some text errors.

I plan to adjust some UI in the two updates next week, and speed up the month passing speed of the Strategic map and the battle animation speed. See you next week!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 0.7.6Update
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

The balance of the units is a major topic discussed recently. Due to the appearance of the artillery, the value of agility has been greatly reduced. The weakening of submarines has also greatly reduced the value of diving. Therefore, in this update, I reduced the weight of some values and adjusted all units. 2. Fixed a bug that the policy Gold Diplomacy did not take effect.

An important part of this update is the adjustment of the policy tree of the Free Stars. After adjustment, the Free Stars will get advanced blueprint and enhancements faster. However, if you are playing with this faction before the update, you may encounter the problem of unable to obtain some blueprints because of this modification. 2. The attack time of aliens was postponed from April to July.
3. The labor output of the Immigration Office has been improved.
4. There will be no more rebels on the wasteland planets.
5. Reduced the mission reward of assassins.

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.notes:
Finally, It is this day! Friends, the complexity of this sequel is far beyond my initial imagination. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for nearly two years.

The core gameplay content of Chaos Galaxy 2 has been basically completed. However, there are several important contents, such as playable Alien Faction, which have not yet been finished. In the next six months, I will finish the rest content, and listen to your opinions to add or adjust the game content.

The following picture is the development plan of CG2 for the next half year. Only the most important contents are listed. But the work to be done is far more than that. I may add new inspiration that I haven't mentioned, or delete the inappropriate content in this plan. Therefore, the final product may deviate from the plan. But I promise that the version 1.0 of Chaos Galaxy 2 will not only meet my game aesthetics, but also meet the common preferences of most of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/8e346a998bba6d0200f5980b1b320ffacd708bac.png[/img]

In addition, in the past two months, I have been busy making diplomacy, events, and all the faction rules. The work is very complex, and it is likely that you will experience some bugs. During the EA, the game content will also change frequently, so bugs are inevitable. When you encounter bugs, please don't rush to make bad comments. Please describe these bugs on Steam community or Discord. I promise that as long as you submit the bug you find, I will repair and update it as soon as possible. Thank you very much!

Now, Lord Admirals, please board your flagship and conquer the Galaxy!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: The last dev log before EA
notes.notes:
I've been working very busy for the past 2 months, and I finally finished all the content of the game today. In next week, Chaos Galaxy 2 will start the Early Access, and the monthly dev log will be over. Later, I will communicate with you by the game update and roadmap. I hope you can work with me to make this game better in the next 6-9 months.

Now let me introduce to you the recent development contents.

First of all, the game will support three control modes: mouse, controller and keyboard. The rule are shown in the picture below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/3757a9355cfcab8f5fda39f480ebf95eed651d8d.png[/img]
Next is the largest content of the game: the faction rule system. All factions in the game belong to 8 different faction types. Different faction types will have a completely unique playing rules and an unique building.

1 imperial
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/10462d30aac6cffd3d7e01233c7873366966e692.png[/img]
The imperial rank system has been shown in demo. The main difference of the new version is that it uses a new prestige of imperial influence, and Imperial factions can consume influence to compete for ranks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/629f2a699134a4feb151329fcf61ba24423abc6f.png[/img]

2 Traders
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/433a35b88d9cd0758d80580eb62086cf1242178a.png[/img]
Traders can choose proposals for investment. The higher the level of the exchange, the better the investment proposal will be put forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/64618614c8bef37ab0100cb01f323684471179fd.png[/img]
Traders are also the only faction that can trade supplies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/6790250688e6fa231b0204579eabae80f87093e8.png[/img]

3 Pirates
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/1c494636a2287371925e9e9463e9b205cc5aaac3.png[/img]
Enemy units fleeing in battle may be captured by the Pirates. Captured units can be disbanded for supplies, or put into the Pirates' garage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/fa96be10dd79dc63e8c7ad9e7586bc442b9e55d5.png[/img]
When our fleet is on our planet, we can mobilize units from garage to join the fleet instead of recruiting new units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/72f3704264d486ee11a19cc4a9e283da45aad7ca.png[/img]

4 Mercenary
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/a605934aa951310504b90f406a2117b3027e21ce.png[/img]
Mercenaries can accept the missionof attacking planets. When accepting the mission, they will receive a deposit of gold or supplies. If they capture the planet within a year, they will give the planet to the entrusting faction and obtain the military reputation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/4a3e2b96518951f86672f0c0267eb50afd8d13c1.png[/img]
Using military reputation can improve the power, energy and agility of all your units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/b5a5ea32b450c28a0c27001c1d77f376bd0f7ad7.png[/img]

5 Assassin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/a7cb6bd28d464c21d865628001e07e69c5c3e6da.png[/img]
The Assassins can accept the mission of assassinating the commander of the enemy fleet. When accepting the mission, you will receive a deposit of gold or supplies. Within half a year, if you can complete the mission, whether by plotting to assassinate or by fighting to destroy the target fleet, and get the Assassin reputation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/d77c373ca9a735c912546f36fb166b64d67847e9.png[/img]
The Assassin reputation can improve the success rate of strategy and assassin skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/238d87a5cf4b199de31c39a036c6ff23c6c5a5dd.png[/img]

6 Omnic
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/5bbd2386d6982d67021a6f7316b333b785b8393f.png[/img]
When the Omnic AI legion destroy the enemy's advanced units in battle, you will gain the technical mastery of this unit. Each time they destroy this unit, the mastery will increase. You can also use learning points to accelerate the mastery.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/734bb88cb805ffe23bc14d547f1b41f905240aa9.png[/img]
When the mastery reaches 100%, you can decode the blueprint of the unit. This unit can be recruited from now on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/219c6504b1b704aaf885b8ad2b399fa639035aac.png[/img]

7 Liberal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/617b6bf7ff5a4d3cb941ff5ecf67c4451a58c04c.png[/img]
The Liberal faction can carry out revolutionary actions, send agents to the surrounding planets to increase the resistance, or destroy the Planetary Defense. When the resistance exceeds 50, you can incite an uprising. After success, a Liberal fleet will appear. When they capture the planet, the Liberal fleet will disappear and give the planet to us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/dc5490eb8aeafb700acacb73fe728310e143b51b.png[/img]

In addition to this new system, the diplomacy system also adds the function of Alienation. When you are a vassal, you can even incite your suzerain‘s dissatisfaction with other vassals and trigger a civil war.

Of course, there are a lot of new events. There will be a series of events around  the princess Jing.

There are two other things to tell you.

Because the alien faction still have many contents that need to be refined, they were not selectable at the beginning of Early Access. It is expected that by the end of September, you can use aliens. Please wait for the roadmap of EA to see the detail.

By the way, the content of demo has been integrated into the game ontology as tutorial. And the content of demo is far behind the current version, so when EA starts, I will close the download of demo.

To say again, The Early Access of Chaos Galaxy 2 will start on July 25. Let's have a carnival, friends!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Dev Diary of May
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

In the past month, I have comprehensively improved the whole game based on the demo.

The first is the operation mode of the fleets and troops. Each time the troops are selected, they will enter the moving state. After moving (or clicking on themselves), the command list will appear. When selecting the direction, you can place the mouse on the up, down, left and right positions of the army to change the direction, and press the left mouse at any position to determine the direction. In any case, right-click to go back to the previous step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/e772cfdc5ade4d5f6b05a1ed21aaed50187a0c62.png[/img]

In each scene of the game, a tip is added at the bottom of the screen. (The tips can be turned off in game options.)

When selecting target, you can move the mouse to view the status of the target fleet or target troop.

The galaxy map can be zoomed out once more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/6ac0b7c3ea9c087a2c39ff5a0ba2de14b8d465f0.png[/img]

The planetary UI has also been greatly changed. Now you can click the left or right button of the planet name to switch and display your other planets. The panel no longer shows how many buildings you have, but shows the various resources produced by the planet every month. Putting the mouse on the number, you can see what factors affect the resource income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/23a7332e0d18dcb0bfc25d3534374a60d0bc87cf.png[/img]

There is another interesting modification. The ship ram or drill in CG1 is of little use, but in CG2, the ram can push the enemy troop back by one tile. If there is an  other troop behind the enemy, it will cause additional impact damage to these two troops. If there is a map boundary behind the enemy, you can even drive it out of the battlefield! If you play mercenary faction, it will be very happy to rush into the enemy's formation with ramships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/1333c44fc50b647513be4d39f69d65846c6f88f1.png[/img]

My friends, see you next month.

Han Zhiyu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/8be99068303065978dc05ada20a5c908760e8734.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

There are more than 100 characters and nearly 300 units are available in Chaos Galaxy 2, so the number of art resources is also very large. For the last four months, I have been drawing art resources all the time. Finally, by the last day of March, the art resources of all commanders and units have been completed!

Now I think I can announce the Early Access time of CG2 —— 28th July. If everything goes well, it will be on that day. 

Now let me introduce a new game system of Chaos Galaxy 2: Aeroplane

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/0ad0bd48c42c453b4d4d83aba1c93b2432db58bd.png[/img]

Aeroplane is a new unit type added in CG2. These units have the ability Hit and Run. That ablity allow the unit move again after the attack. Your aeroplane will become the horse archer on the space battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/831dee13660a5d5c9b62913216f18efc911edc05.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/416326380cfe53c5b71ae272b0b8106b35db324f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/8f6432a35205441ae544f1ee0a5df47abccc92fa.png[/img]

There are more than a dozen aeroplane blueprints in game. Some characters also have special aeroplanes as their command units, their power are above most Recruitable aeroplanes. Collect them in the game!

My friends, see you next month.

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Dev Diary of Jan
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

This month, I am continuing to produce unit art resources. I expected that 70% of the art will be completed by the end of the month. The process of making a game is like this: a few weeks of wonderful inspiration and more than a year of boring work. Thanks for your patience. I will try my best to speed up the progress.

On discord, Umbrae Stragis shared some interesting ideas with us: what will the characters of Chaos Galaxy do in the new year?

[i]I bet Duke Gaoshan has some sort of ceremonial parade where he rides around on a palanquin. He probably also displays the princess in her own palanquin so that no one can question his legitimacy. 

Eastgalaxy corp probably has a mercantile holiday? And Kleven maybe throws a party with all the executive members of his corporation?

Pretty sure Li Chengsong's faction goes to visit the graves of their loved ones. The girl (whose name I can't recall) goes to visit the grave of her dead fiance, and Li Chengsong visits his father's grave.

Lycurgus and Hera probably hold some kind of olympian sporting event to celebrate the coming of the new year, and the winners are granted the chance to pilot elite mechs like Ares.

I can totally see them seated in the royal wing of a Colosseum looking on as gladiator mechs fight to the death. 

That angry looking guy from Southheaven fleet probably goes around checking how the preparations for his revolution are coming along and making connections with people he'll need in the coming war, like networking. Chen Hentai... I mean Wentai, probably works overtime to assess troop morale and tries to throw together entertainment for the new year to distract the galactic empire.

Bontenmaru, now I'm not sure how everyone else sees her character, but in my opinion, probably lets all her troops celebrate and do their own thing while she retires to a secret mountain lair or something to meditate next to a candle in a dark room while holding a Katana, trying to gain a better understanding for the way of the sword and by extension life.

The leader of the Kurushima pirates strikes me as the sort of guy who is loved by his people, so they probably have a celebration where he is sorta like the chief guest? And they all make plans for the future and do wholesome stuff for the betterment of their community, while also plotting ambushes against the galactic empire.

Black Khalif Jihad... they probably have some kind of mandatory sermon by the Khalif that everyone has to attend? And they renew their faith in the religion that he preaches and maybe make sacrifices and whatnot, who knows, BKJ is a bit of  mystery to me. 

The Omnic Apocalypse will probably lauch a major invasion knowing full well that most human factions would be engaged in celebration or festivities and would not be expecting the spanish inquisition... I mean Omnic assault. But then they would be thwarted by the Mozi Order cause they built the AI and they know how they think and are always cautions.

Your friendly neighborhood assassins would of course be engaged in the shadow war, taking pot shots at high profile targets and using the revelry to help them blend in and disappear.[/i]

Umbrae stragis is really an imaginative guy, isn't he? I think Duke Gaoshan may deliver a new year's speech on galaxy TV, but unfortunately no one watches. Maybe he'll text everyone's phones. Do you have any interesting ideas?

Finally, Let's see the New Year wishes from Princess Jing. Let's meet again next month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/c50f3580707db303252821cab72b405b36eafe35.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary of Dec
notes.notes:
Happy Christmas Eve!

Steam Winter Sale has begun. Chaos Galaxy and Chaos Sector are both on sale now.

In recent months, my main work is to make art resources of units. I plan to finish all art of nearly 300 units before next March.

Now let me introduce the new artillery weapons in CG2.

The feature of artillery weapon is that it must be used in place. Once the unit is moved, the weapon cannot be used. There are three kinds of artillery weapons in CG2: Bombard Gun, Siege Gun and Hammerfall.

The Bombard Gun is the most basic artillery weapon, but it also has more damage than the Lance. 
Weapon Range: 2-4 Damage Range: 1 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/0c7652f7ed3957a4d6fdb80b4700344e1ce4647e.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/6d20c780572bde34e1469c336748d2c7af2cbb60.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/770d272e7d9569994f7b6dc93ca3e8f5adce32e0.png[/img]

The Siege Gun is the most powerful of all weapons in the game. 
Weapon Range: 2-4 Damage Range: 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/6778692685d5c6dd9232a0212e7d057d1caf3d0b.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/6d20c780572bde34e1469c336748d2c7af2cbb60.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/770d272e7d9569994f7b6dc93ca3e8f5adce32e0.png[/img]

Although the Hammerfall is slightly less powerful than the Siege Gun, it has a larger range and can cause a wide range damage. 
Weapon Range: 3-5 Damage Range: 1-2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/bc4a36073e5480471e86da8f3441bd01490b5308.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/76733da01a9467a41288f6d2dfa46338ecb40dcc.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/d28405c9e57b8c1aa5beb988f99daacfd45d3653.png[/img]

On the battlefield, these units can hide behind the front line and  cause great damage to the opponent. Therefore, breaking through the enemy's defense line to destroy the enemy's artillery will also be the priority goal of fleet commanders.

That's the end of this log. My friends, see you next month!

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Dev Diary of Nov
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

Today, I finished the portraits and small models of all the characters. Including rebels and aliens, there are 117 characters in Chaos Galaxy 2, almost twice as many as the previous game has. All characters have their own unique stories, talents, tactics and flagship. I blieve these new characters will bring richer  storylines and more interesting game content.

The new system introduced to you this month is the Intellect and the Strategy in Chaos Galaxy 2.

In this game, every character has one more ability besides Military and Admin: intellect. This ability is mainly reflected in the Strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/02287226c6ba0611de37b90eb583de53856c03cb.png[/img]

Each character has and only has one Strategy. Some Strategies can confuse the enemy, reduce the enemy's power or supply efficiency. Some Strategies can destroy the defense of the enemy planet and increase the resistance. There is also a Strategy to allow our fleet to do a forced march.

The fleet strategy value is increased according to the intellect of the commander every month. You can use Strategy only when the fleet strategy slot is full. Intellect also affect the effect and success probability of the Strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/29098f7c233a8facff7f96bcb58e3323f867e01c.png[/img]

By making good use of Strategies, your thinking type commander will play an unimaginable role in the war. Sun Tzu said: The skillful leader subdues the enemy's troops without any fighting, his triumph will be complete.

My friends, see you next month!

Han Zhiyu

notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

At the first week of this month, Chaos Galaxy 2 participated in Steam Next Fest. During the  Fest, the demo of Chaos Galaxy 2 was downloaded more than 2000 times, the wishlists increased by more than 1000, the followers increased by more than 100, and more than 500 players watched my game live at the same time. It's much more than I expected. Thank you for your support!

Now let me introduce a new game system of Chaos Galaxy 2: The rebels.

Each of the 80 planets on the Galactic map has its own culture. When the resistance of the planet is very high, different cultural planets will have different rebels, and their fleet composition is also different.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/43bd6c35d9b8c730d5c60f2f93904b775b778d6a.png[/img]

One is the spaceworm group that only appear in the great sandsea area. They will indiscriminately attack fleets within sight.

The other is the revolutionary army, which was raised by the instigation of the Free Stars. When they capture a planet, the planet will immediately join the Free Stars.

My friends, see you next month!

notes.title: Dev Diary of Aug and Sep
notes.notes:
Hi, my friends!

I was busy making the demo recently, so the development logs of these two months were merged into this one log.

Now you can see the latest Chaos Galaxy 2 game video on the store page. In addition to some contents introduced before, the most important new part is the modification of fight animation.

In Chaos Sector and Chaos Galaxy, I use the side view fight animation similar to Gihren no Yabou and Super Robot War. Although it can express the battle process more clearly, the robot animations need a lot of hand-painted frames. There are only 100 combat units in Chaos Galaxy, so the work time of a few months was acceptable. However, in Chaos Galaxy 2, there will be about 300 combat units, so it is difficult to use the previous resources production way for the fight animation(which means that it will take more than a year only to draw these frames).

Therefore, I used the map chess combat animation similar to Tactics Ogre. After more than a month of testing, it seems that the effect is good. You can see the actua battle shows in the game video.

Now the game demo has reached the final stage. I am making the game help tips. I believe I can finish the work on time by the end of this month and eliminate most bugs.

Please look forward to the upcoming Steam Next Fest. My friends, see you next month!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Dev Diary of July
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's time for us to share the development progress of this month.

The development of Chaos Galaxy 2 Demo is going smoothly. I plan to release it on the Steam Next Fest on October 1st (Maybe a little earlier).

Now let me introduce the alien faction in Chaos Galaxy 2. Perhaps some friends have experienced the Typhoeus Hive Fleet in Chaos Sector. But in the new background, the Typhoeus fleet is only the pioneer of the 2nd alien impact. The number of alien heroes and alien units in Chaos Galaxy 2 will be three times more than in Chaos Sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/7697d3f403b7ac03f31ec488d66fafe1bbb239f8.png[/img]

Aliens will use a completely different currency from humans, that is life genes, which can only be gained by fighting and devour planets. Both breeding new troops and making evolution (faction poliy) will takes life genes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/04aca3bf79e2128c01375c68a0b9500ce4e2567d.png[/img]

Aliens cannot collect taxes from the planets. When they capture a planet, they will devour and digest all life on the planet and store it in the form of life genes. The planet will become wasteland after that. Only after mastering the ecological restoration technology can human factions to restore the planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/b033862f88cfc1cc8c806d12402a350db76b9f7e.png[/img]

In short, the play way of aliens is completely different from humans! Their design details are still being refined.

See you next month!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Dev Diary of May and June
notes.notes:
I didn't post the dev diary last month because I've been working hard to make the demo, and I want to show it to you at steam Summer Festival. However, I overestimated my work efficiency. In the week of deadline, I only slept about ten hours, trying to finish my work at the last moment. I almost succeeded, leaving only the last few problems to be solved. But in the end, I found that it's better to give up. To give you a game version full of bugs and many functions are not perfect, it's not a good thing at all. So, I must apologize for not fulfilling the promise of releasing demo in mid June.

But the hard work during this period has greatly accelerated the development of the game. The framework of the game has been basically completed. In the remaining half a year, I can focus on content filling and fuctions optimization.

Before the official sale, there will still be a demo, but since this failure, I can't tell you the specific time by now. But I'll release the news in fit time.

In addition, I want to show you some newly completed game systems.

1. This is the recruitment UI. It needs your fleet to stay on the planet as before, but it will consume the ship production capacity and weapon production capacity.(Alien has a different recruitment  system)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/1e4bbf45c284c25004b2ba7bde1d27d6ba2246b4.png[/img]

2. Commanders can implant skill chips into their brains so they can master new skills. The commander will not choose from 3 random skills when level up. Instead, he will unlock the chip slot which you can implant the skill chip produced by the Institute into it. In addition, the AI commanders will insert the chip into their CPU...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/08c29808508b77a1cdac149082fa1a18cf2597be.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/b12f083bacd60731b0cac8823e41a9bc799eb72c.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary of April
notes.notes:
At the beginning of this month, I got dizzy for a week. It seems that my sickness is caused by drinking too much coffee and staying up late. I can't stand steadily when I walking, and I see double images on the computer screen. So I have to sleep and rest, and go outdoors to enjoy the spring blooming season.

Thanks to the beautiful nature and the help of my family, I got recovered soon and was able to devote myself to the production of Chaos Galaxy 2 again.

Now let me introduce my main work of this month: the planetary building mechanism.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/a472a30cf6d0e61c09926942dcbbe781a1a46ef1.png[/img]
Each planet has a command center on the surface, as well as many other buildings can be built on the suface too. On orbit, we can build shipyards, arm factories, commercial ports, space fortresses and orbital minefileds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/10cd49afaf5e45352e0493815afb1fa6a0368491.png[/img]
Different planets can build different number of buildings. The more important the planet, the more buildings can be built on it.

Each type of faction has its own unique building. For example, Imperial factions can build the governor office, to suppress resistance and speed up the development of planets. Merchant faction can build trading centers for trading gold and suplies. Assassin faction can build cave mazes to slow down enemy occupation, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40095185/039fcbfae4449f2e4fb0d484a1ec034287d3a544.png[/img]
In addition, buildings in orbit will also have a significant effect on planetary warfare. Shipyards, arms factories and commercial ports, fortresses and mines will all appear on the battlefield. Ship units can restore power in shipyards, arm units can restore power in arms factories, and all units can restore energy in commercial port. The fortress can join the defensive battle. mines are invisible units, which can cause fire, corrosion, EMP, gravity vortex and so on.

There are many other interesting uses of buildings. Please explore them in Chaos Galaxy 2 later!

See you next month!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Welcome to Chaos Galaxy 2
notes.notes:
Hey! I'm Han Zhiyu, the indie developer of Chaos Galaxy series.

Since I was a child, I have been addicted to such Strategic games as Romance of The Three Kingdoms, Super Robot War and Advance Wars, etc. I have played hundreds of such games. After ten years of working in big game companies, I decided to follow my childhood dream, resigned and began to make my favorite grand strategy games by myself. 

After more than one year's development, an experimental work called Chaos Sector was published on Steam. After another year and a half, Chaos Galaxy, the first major work of the Chaos universe is finally complete.

The Chaos Galaxy series can be simply described as the Three Kingdoms on the Galactic stage. The heroes command huge starships and drive mecha to fight for hegemony. At the same time, terrible alien and AI legion are trying to destroy all human beings. This is a story of modern space opera that mixed with the ancient China style. (By the way, I am also a Chinese translator of Warhammer 40K novels, such as Dark Imperium and  Visions of Heresy.)

Chaos Galaxy 2 is the latest generation of Chaos Galaxy series. The story and game fun is further expanded than before. The number of heroes has reached 108. More than 200 unit types can be used in battle. In addition, I plan to develop Workshop or Level editor.

I expect to release the demo of Chaos Galaxy 2 in mid June and Early Access by the end of this year. Every month I will announce the development progress and interesting game information of that month.

So, see you next month. Hope you will add Chaos Galaxy 2 to your wishlist and keep attention. Welcome to join Chaos Galaxy on Discord: https://discord.gg/KDMtCtj

Thank you!
